title: Naturally Sweet Turkish Strawberry Pilaf
description: A briny and shaggy crowd-pleaser Turkish dish featuring strawberries and lamination-puff, perfect for vegetarians
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened.
Add the sliced strawberries to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked strawberry and onion mixture, basmati rice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Spoon the rice mixture onto one half of the puff pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the crumbly feta cheese over the top of the rice mixture.
Fold the other half of the puff pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with a little bit of water and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Bake the pilaf in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
